notes:
- Wide shots are centred on the people themselves: someone sitting side-on no longer ends up at the edge of the frame.
- Stutters and repeated words play once (\"I, I, I thank\" becomes \"I thank\"), cut cleanly on the start of the next word even when there is no pause.
- The music is set to the level you picked.
- The on-screen text hook (two lines, the second in brackets) is only on formats with text above the picture: Letterbox, Headline and Wraparound. Hook Box and the others keep a short one-line hook.
